paper.title_en: Lost in the Signal Model: Confusion Between Deterministic and Stochastic Gravitational Wave Signals in Pulsar Timing Array Data
paper.abstract_en: With growing evidence for the presence of a gravitational wave background (GWB) in pulsar timing array (PTA) data, it is imperative to understand how this signal will act as a foreground for other GW signals, particularly those from individual supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), which are predicted to be detected in the next decade. For PTAs, since these two types of signals are long-timescale persistent signals, a signal from an SMBHB system may already be present in the latest PTA datasets. In this work, we analyze how the presence of this signal could affect our detection statistics for the GWB, and how the presence of the GWB can affect our search for the SMBHB system. We find that individual SMBHB signals can significantly skew the recovery of the GWB amplitude and spectral index. However, when the SMBHB signals are recovered consistently, we are again able to recover the GWB power-law parameters, highlighting the importance of joint searches in future PTA searches for GWs. We also explore the rate of improvement of parameter estimation uncertainty, giving insight to the types of signals most likely to be identified well enough to enable multimessenger analyses.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接研究脉冲星计时阵列数据中随机引力波背景与单个超大质量双黑洞确定性信号之间的相互混淆，属于PTA数据分析主题，问题具体且对联合搜索有实际意义；但理论深度有限，更偏数据分析方法学。
decision.title_zh: 迷失于信号模型：脉冲星计时阵列数据中确定性引力波信号与随机引力波信号的混淆
decision.abstract_zh: 随着脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）数据中引力波背景（GWB）存在证据的不断增长，理解这一信号将如何作为前景影响其他引力波信号变得至关重要，尤其是来自单个超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）的信号，这些信号预计将在未来十年内被探测到。对于PTA而言，由于这两类信号都是长时标的持续信号，来自SMBHB系统的信号可能已经存在于最新的PTA数据集中。在本工作中，我们分析了该信号的存在会如何影响我们对GWB的探测统计量，以及GWB的存在会如何影响我们对SMBHB系统的搜寻。我们发现，单个SMBHB信号能显著扭曲对GWB振幅和谱指数的恢复。然而，当SMBHB信号被一致地恢复时，我们又能重新恢复GWB的幂律参数，这凸显了在未来PTA引力波搜寻中进行联合搜寻的重要性。我们还探讨了参数估计不确定度改善的速率，从而为哪些类型的信号最有可能被足够好地识别、进而支持多信使分析提供了洞见。
